title: Upgrade action is available to SUPERADMIN on the Plans tab after a deploy
preconditions: Org is on a self-serve tier below the top public plan
steps: Confirm an upgrade CTA is present and clickable for at least one higher self-serve tier
expectedResult: Upgrade CTA is visible and opens UpgradeModal, which submits a plan-change SubscriptionRequest (no immediate plan change) — no regression hid the action after the last deploy.
description: Upgrade CTA on the Plans tab now submits a plan-change SubscriptionRequest via UpgradeModal rather than performing an immediate self-serve upgrade.

title: Downgrade UI correctly blocks an enterprise-tier org and surfaces the CSM contact path
steps: Attempt to select a downgrade target
expectedResult: DowngradeModal shows its 'blocked' state referencing csm@vibrantix.ai, matching the backend's 409 DOWNGRADE_NOT_ALLOWED — the UI does not let the request silently no-op or show a generic error.
description: Superseded by the 2026-08-04 billing rewrite — there is no enterprise-tier downgrade block or csm@vibrantix.ai contact path in the current DowngradeModal.jsx; every tier's downgrade now submits an identical SubscriptionRequest regardless of current tier.

title: TierGate renders the correct required-tier name for a known gated feature
preconditions: Org on a tier below the one required for a known gated feature (e.g. vciso.advisor)
steps: Navigate to the gated feature's page
expectedResult: Alert text names the actual required tier for that feature (matches plan.features/moduleDefaults), not a stale or hardcoded tier name left over from a previous pricing revision.
description: Superseded by the 2026-08-04 billing rewrite — TierGate.jsx no longer names the required tier at all; its alert copy is now the generic 'This feature is not included in your current plan.' with a 'View plans' link. See BILL-SAN-006 for a case tracking this as a possible UX regression.

title: 'Set up payment' CTA appears only when plan.status or a framework's status is pending_payment
preconditions: Org has an active, fully-paid subscription with no pending_payment states
expectedResult: 'Set up payment' CTA is absent, since neither plan.status nor any framework is pending_payment.
description: Superseded by the 2026-08-04 billing rewrite — there is no 'Set up payment' CTA, pending_payment Stripe state, or payment-setup flow anywhere in the current BillingOverview.jsx/billingService.js.

title: 'Renews In N Days' stat recalculates correctly immediately after a plan upgrade
preconditions: Org just completed a self-serve upgrade in the current session
steps: Check the 'Renews In N Days' stat card on Overview
expectedResult: N reflects the days between now and the (possibly updated) renewsAt returned by the upgrade response, not a stale value cached from before the upgrade.
description: Superseded by the 2026-08-04 billing rewrite — plan changes are no longer instant (they are SubscriptionRequests pending admin/MSSP approval), so a 'Renews In N Days' recalculation 'immediately after a self-serve upgrade' cannot occur; the stat only changes once a request is actually applied.

title: TierGate's generic 'not included in your current plan' copy no longer names the required tier — confirm this is accepted, not a shipped regression
preconditions: Org on a plan lacking a boolean-gated feature (e.g. module.vciso.enabled=false)
expectedResult: Current behavior: the alert reads 'Feature not included' / 'This feature is not included in your current plan.' with a generic 'View plans' button — it does not name which tier or plan actually includes the feature, unlike the pre-rewrite TierGate. Confirm with product whether this is an accepted simplification or an unintentional loss of self-serve guidance.

title: PendingDowngradeBanner.jsx is orphaned dead code post-rewrite — plan.pendingChange is never populated by GET /v1/subscriptions/current
preconditions: Org has a pending (submitted/approved) downgrade SubscriptionRequest
steps: Inspect the response body of GET /v1/subscriptions/current for the 'plan' object's fields
Confirm PendingDowngradeBanner is still imported and rendered in BillingPlans.jsx
expectedResult: The 'plan' object returned by GET /current has no 'pendingChange' key in the current codebase, so PendingDowngradeBanner's `if (!pendingChange || pendingChange.status !== 'scheduled') return null;` guard always short-circuits to null. Recommend either wiring plan.pendingChange from the org's open downgrade/cancel requests, or removing the now-dead component and its NO_PENDING_CHANGE handling (see BILL-REG-002's deprecation note) as part of this rewrite's cleanup.
